extension.summary: Client ClassicalRadio non officiel pour Kodi
extension.description: Listen to ClassicalRadio with your AudioAddict account. Browse all channels, styles, popular and new channels, synchronise favourites, select Premium audio quality, and use Kodi's native player controls.

Écoutez ClassicalRadio avec votre compte AudioAddict. Parcourez toutes les chaînes, les styles, les chaînes populaires et nouvelles, synchronisez vos favoris, choisissez la qualité audio Premium et utilisez les contrôles natifs de Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial community add-on. Requires a valid AudioAddict/ClassicalRadio account. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by ClassicalRadio or AudioAddict.
Extension communautaire non officielle. Nécessite un compte AudioAddict/ClassicalRadio valide. Sans affiliation avec ClassicalRadio ou AudioAddict, et non approuvée ni prise en charge par eux.
extension.news: Version 1.0.2 - Added cross-platform playback-state locking for Windows and Unix-like systems. - Improved playback-state handling to prevent stale track metadata. - Hardened authentication and HTTP redirect handling. - Improved playlist URL validation and stream fallback robustness. - Added retry handling for transient track metadata errors. - Fixed favorite channel ID normalization. - Improved error handling and logging. - General stability and security improvements.
